original_question: On which chromosome is the GBE1 gene located, whose mutation causes Glycogen Storage Disease Type IV?

final_qi.question: On which chromosome is the GBE1 gene located, whose mutation causes Glycogen Storage Disease Type IV?
final_qi.long_answer: The GBE1 gene, which encodes the glycogen-branching enzyme whose deficiency leads to Glycogen Storage Disease Type IV (Andersen disease), is mapped to the short arm of human chromosome 3 (cytogenetic band 3p12).
